messages:
zoe: Heads-up: discovered a small but confusing copy gap — the Console's doc inlay header reads 'Service endpoints' while our reference page and examples use the word 'route'. Users hit the inlay and then the doc and see two different terms.

marc: Ugh. Are these interchangeable in practice? Does 'route' map to a YAML field or runtime concept?

felipe: Docs note: 'route' is used in the API examples because it's the field name in the manifest. But customers generally search for 'endpoints' or 'service endpoints'.

zoe: UX impact: the inlay is tiny on narrow screens; long parentheticals break layout. We should avoid 'Service endpoints (routes)'.

aria-bot: accessibility-check: voiceover reads heading text verbatim. Mismatch will sound inconsistent to screen-reader users.

marc: Options: 1) Make Console copy match docs ('Routes'), 2) Make docs show 'Endpoints' as primary and mention 'route' in a glossary, 3) Keep both but show a tiny 'Terminology' link in the inlay that opens the glossary.

felipe: Preference: keep Console user-facing term 'Endpoints' (better surface for non-devs), but add a prominent alias line at top of the docs: "Endpoints (referred to in API manifests as 'route')". Also add a short redirect from /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints to catch old links.

zoe: Design: I'll prototype a compact micro-link next to the inlay title: small icon + 'Terminology' tooltip that opens the glossary anchor. That avoids long inline text and prevents wrap on mobile.

engflow: Implementation: I can add a search synonym mapping (route -> endpoints) and a 301 redirect for /docs/routes. Also update aria-labels to be consistent: e.g., aria-label='Endpoints help, opens glossary'. Will feature-flag it so we can rollback.

marc: Agree with that plan. One more ask: update our style guide (copy guide) to state 'Endpoints' as the Console-facing term and 'route' as the API-level term. Felipe, can you add the note to the docs style guide?

felipe: Yep, I'll add the style-guide blurb and draft the alias sentence in the endpoints reference page. Target EOD Friday for the docs change.

zoe: I'll post the Figma frame when it's ready and run a quick screen-reader pass on the new aria text.

engflow: I'll queue the redirect and search synonym in the next deploy window and leave the feature flag off until we have the docs commit.

marc: Owners: design=zoe, docs=felipe, eng=engflow. Decision: Console uses 'Endpoints' publicly; docs annotate alias 'route' and maintain API examples. :thumbsup:
